uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

728-6972-7231.notablePrerequisites: There are at least X creature cards in all graveyards.
728-6972-7231.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Drakestown Forgotten.
When Drakestown Forgotten dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

620-2111-2292.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Wingrattle Scarecrow
When Wingrattle Scarecrow dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Wingrattle Scarecrow enters, Yotian Dissident triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Wingrattle Scarecrow
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it

4094-4365-6664-6753-7942.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and The Wandering Minstrel.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat from step 2

2073-2292-6808-7878.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is 12 or less.
2073-2292-6808-7878.description:
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning The Last Ride from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When The Last Ride enters, Kolodin triggers, causing The Last Ride to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing The Last Ride.
When The Last Ride dies, Salvaging Station triggers, untapping Salvaging Station.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

1978-2734-7826.easyPrerequisites: You control at least three Foods.
1978-2734-7826.description:
Animate Bag End Banquet using Cyberdrive Awakener.
Activate Bag End Banquet by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Bag End Banquet.
Repeat from step 2.

4377-4428-7757-7758.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that can attack and that cannot be blocked or killed by an opponent.
4377-4428-7757-7758.description:
Declare any creature as an attacker. When you do, Doom's Time Platform triggers, exiling Walk the Aeons from your graveyard with two time counters on it.
Blink Shivan Sand-Mage using Thassa.
When Shivan Sand-Mage enters, it triggers, removing two time counters from Walk the Aeons.
Walk the Aeons's suspend ability triggers, causing you to cast it without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Walk the Aeons, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

2438-5220-6900-7452.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing it.
When Carrion Feeder dies, Mortuary and Cauldron of Essence trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Carrion Feeder from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Cauldron of Essence trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Cast Carrion Feeder from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

223-5941-7411.notablePrerequisites: You have not cast an instant spell this turn.
223-5941-7411.description:
Cast Gravitic Punch by paying its mana cost, targeting Kalamax.
Holding priority, cast Wild Ricochet by paying its mana cost, targeting Gravitic Punch.
Kalamax's first and second abilities trigger.
Resolve the first ability, creating a copy of Wild Ricochet targeting the original Wild Ricochet.
Resolve the second ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Kalamax.
Resolve the Wild Ricochet copy, creating a copy of Wild Ricochet, targeting the original Wild Ricochet.
Kalamax's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Repeat from step 6 any number of times.
Once you have an arbitrarily large Kalamax, have the final Wild Ricochet copy target Gravitic Punch. This'll create two copies of Gravitic Punch in addition to the original Gravitic Punch.
Resolve all Gravitic Punches, dealing infinite damage to each of up to three opponents.

2308-4268-4871-5231.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to gain any amount of life.
2308-4268-4871-5231.description:
Gain any amount of life.
Trudge Garden triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a 4/4 Fungus Beast creature token.
When the Fungus Beast enters, Kor Celebrant triggers.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Fungus Beast, adding {R}.
When the Fungus Beast dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Holding priority, activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Resolve the Kor Celebrant trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

3388-5282-7149.description:
Cast Moritte of the Frost either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{G}{U}{U} plus commander tax if applicable. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Princess Yue.
Put Moritte of the Frost into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Moritte of the Frost dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield as a land named Moon. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Wormfang Newt, gaining its abilities.
When Moritte of the Frost enters, its first ability triggers, exiling it.
When Moritte of the Frost leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Moritte of the Frost from exile to the battlefield. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Princess Yue.
Repeat from step 2.

3129-5259-5702.easyPrerequisites: You control a Forest that enters the battlefield untapped.
3129-5259-5702.description:
Animate a Forest that enters untapped using Rude Awakening
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the animated Forest.
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
When the Forest tokens enter, Springheart Nantuko triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate the Forest tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
Repeat from step 4.

2866-2981-4708-4986.description:
Cast Dark Sphere by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Dark Sphere by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Megatog by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Dark Sphere from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Megatog ability.
Repeat.

1482-4053-4740-6613.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 4 if you've cast two or more spells this turn, 5 if you've cast one spell this turn, or 7 otherwise.
1482-4053-4740-6613.description:
Cast Jeweled Lotus from your graveyard by paying {0} and 3 life. It will not enter with a finality counter due to Solemnity.
Aetherflux Reservoir triggers, causing you to gain 1 life for each spell you've cast this turn.
Resolve Jeweled Lotus, and it will not enter with a finality counter due to Solemnity.
Activate Jeweled Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it, adding three mana of any color that can only be spent to cast your commander.
Repeat

1309-3542-6485.notablePrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{G}{U}.
1309-3542-6485.description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{G}{U}.
Cast Rally the Galadhrim by paying {2}{G}{U} and tapping Salvager of Secrets and Palinchron, targeting Salvager of Secrets
Rally the Galadhrim's conspire ability triggers, copying it, targeting Palinchron.
Resolve the copy of Rally the Galadhrim, creating a token copy of Palinchron.
When the Palinchron token enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Resolve the original Rally the Galadhrim, creating a token copy of Salvager of Secrets.
When the Salvager of Secrets token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Rally the Galadhrim from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat, tapping the Salvager of Secrets and Palinchron tokens when casting Rally the Galadhrim instead.

1479-3756-4288.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-3756-4288.description:
Play Izzet Boilerworks.
When Izzet Boilerworks enters the battlefield, it, Sarinth Greatwurm, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Izzet Boilerworks trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Sarinth Greatwurm trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Izzet Boilerworks from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Izzet Boilerworks enters the battlefield, it and Sarinth Greatwurm trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

549-1913-4050-6116.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Haunt of the Dead Marshes, adding {B}.
Activate Haunt of the Dead Marshes by paying {2}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Haunt of the Dead Marshes and Imotekh's first ability trigger.
Resolve the Imotekh trigger, creating two 2/2 Necron Warrior artifact creature tokens.
Resolve the Haunt of the Dead Marshes trigger, causing you to scry 1.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Necron Warriors, adding {2}.
Repeat.

883-1339-4279.notablePrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 2.
You control at least one additional creature.
883-1339-4279.description:
Activate Yawgmoth's first ability by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Ashes of the Abhorrent triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, causing you to draw a card and allowing you to put a -1/-1 counter on up to one creature.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Repeat.

2034-2082-5189.easyPrerequisites: Sadistic Glee attached to a creature you control.
2034-2082-5189.notablePrerequisites: There is at least one removable +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
2034-2082-5189.description:
Activate Ghave's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from a creature you control, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Saproling, adding {C}{C}.
When the Saproling dies, Sadistic Glee triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature it is attached to.
Repeat.

277-623-1737-2544-2713.description:
Activate Prototype Portal by paying {0} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Mistvault Bridge.
When Mistvault Bridge enters the battlefield, Tiller Engine triggers, untapping it.
Activate the Mistvault Bridge token by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Filigree Sages by paying {U}, untapping Prototype Portal.
Repeat.

2460-2544-2757-2949-5279.description:
Activate Throne of Empires by paying {1} and tapping it, creating five 1/1 Soldier creature tokens.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping a Soldier, untapping a basic Island you control.
Activate the Island by tapping it, adding {U}.
Repeat from step 2 three additional times.
Activate Filigree Sages by paying {2}{U}, untapping Throne of Empires.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite Soldiers and mana, you may activate either Scepter of Empires or Crown of Empires' abilities instead.

1878-2634-3593.notablePrerequisites: An opponent has at least three cards in hand.
1878-2634-3593.description:
Cast Jeska's Will by paying {2}{R}.
Holding priority, activate Rootha by paying {2} and returning it from the battlefield to your hand, copying Jeska's Will.
Resolve the copy of Jeska's Will, adding at least {R}{R}{R}.
Activate Sneak Attack by paying {R}, putting Rootha from your hand onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
If an opponent has four or more cards in hand, this combo nets infinite red mana.
If you control your commander, you may also select both of Jeska's Will's modes when casting it to exile your library with the ability to play the exiled cards this turn.

876-1563-2143.description:
Activate Spawnsire of Ulamog's first ability by paying {4}, creating two 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature tokens.
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to an Eldrazi Spawn.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn with Lightning Greaves attached by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn with Lightning Greaves attached by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat from step 2 for the remaining Eldrazi Spawn.
Repeat from step 1.

2034-3234-3942-4377.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least three Islands.
You have not cast a creature spell using Karador this turn.
2034-3234-3942-4377.description:
Activate three Islands by tapping them, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Cast Walk the Aeons with buyback by paying {4}{U}{U} and sacrificing three Islands, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and return Walk the Aeons to your hand.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing World Shaper, adding {C}{C}.
World Shaper dies, triggering its second ability, returning all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Cast World Shaper from your graveyard by paying {3}{G}.
World Shaper enters the battlefield, triggering its first ability, allowing you to mill three cards.
Repeat each turn.

1558-3976-5211.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent is unable to block and kill creatures you control.
You control at least five lands.
1558-3976-5211.description:
Activate Magar by paying {1}{B}{R}, noting Brass's Bounty and putting it face down as a 3/3 creature.
On any other turn, deal combat damage to an opponent with the face down creature.
The face down creature triggers, causing you to cast a copy of Brass's Bounty without paying its mana cost.
Resolve the copy of Brass's Bounty, creating at least five Treasure tokens.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping and sacrificing five Treasures, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat from step 2.

395-1283-2178-4659-4840.notablePrerequisites:
Hanna does not have summoning sickness.
Thornbite Staff attached to Hanna.
395-1283-2178-4659-4840.description:
Cast Myr Battlesphere by paying {7}.
Myr Battlesphere enters the battlefield, creating four 1/1 Myr creature tokens.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Myr Battlesphere, adding {2}.
Myr Battlesphere dies, triggering Hanna, untapping Hanna.
Repeat from step 3 for each of the four Myr creature tokens.
Activate Hanna by paying {3} and tapping it, returning Myr Battlesphere from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

586-2034-2493-2499-2588.description:
Cast Agadeem's Awakening paying {4}{B}{B}{B} returning Priest of Gix and Archaeomancer to the battlefield.
Priest of Gix enters, adding six {B}.
Archaeomancer enters, return Agadeem's Awakening from your graveyard to your hand.
Sacrifice Priest of Gix and Archaeomancer to Ashnod's Altar to add {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

404-955-1521-2105.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
404-955-1521-2105.description:
Declare Flamerush Rider, Combat Celebrant and Ghired as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant, Ghired's second ability and Flamerush Rider trigger.
Resolve the Flamerush Rider trigger, creating a token copy of Combat Celebrant that is tapped and attacking.
Resolve the Ghired trigger, creating a copy of the Combat Celebrant token.
Resolve the Combat Celebrant trigger, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Move to your next combat phase, and declare the Combat Celebrant token created in step 4 and Ghired as attackers, choosing to exert the Combat Celebrant token as it attacks.
Repeat from step 4.
Optionally, you may also attack with Flamerush Rider to get infinite copies of any other attacking creatures you control.

126-2056-2649-3395-4406.notablePrerequisites: One other creature on the battlefield.
126-2056-2649-3395-4406.description:
Mutate Vadrok onto the extra creature.
Use Vadrok's mutate trigger to cast chance for Glory from the graveyard, take an extra turn after this one, and gain a thopter token from Saheeli's trigger.
This token will be your mutate target next turn.
Before the end of turn, pay to activate Crystal Shard and return Vadrok to your hand.
Activate Obeka, Brute Chronologist to exile the lose the game trigger.
Repeat.
